clips.set: a bright ordinary kitchen mid-morning, phone propped against something on the counter

beats.say: I rested it for six weeks. It did nothing.
beats.do: mid-sentence already, talking straight to the phone, slight shrug

beats.say: So I stopped guessing and had someone actually look at it.
beats.do: glances away briefly then back, small dry smile

beats.say: A provider set the plan. One forty four a month.
beats.do: relaxed nod, settles, easy half-smile at the end

clips.set: sitting on the edge of a bed early morning, warm light, phone held slightly above eye level

beats.say: Nobody ever asked me what I had already tried.
beats.do: talking straight to the phone, unhurried, tired but calm

beats.say: The intake did. Then a provider read it before anything shipped.
That was the whole difference for me.
